chapterInfo.content:
19
Yesu firi Galilea
(Marko 10.1-12)
1Na ɛbaa sɛ Yesu wiee nsɛm yi ka no, ɔfirii Galilea, na ɔbaa Yudea ahyeɛ so, Yordan agya. 2Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo pii dii n’akyi, na ɔsaa wɔn yadeɛ wɔ hɔ.
Awaregyaeɛ ho asɛmmisa
3 # Mat 5.31-32 Na Farisifoɔ baa ne nkyɛn bɛsɔɔ no hwɛe, sɛ: Obi wɔ ho kwan sɛ asɛm biara nti ɔgyaa ne yere anaa? 4#Gye 1.27 Na ɔbua see wɔn sɛ: Monkenkanee sɛ ɛfiri mfitiaseɛ no, deɛ ɔbɔɔ onipa no, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa na ɔyɛɛ wɔn? 5#Gye 2.24 Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: Yei nti na ɔbarima bɛgya agya ne ɛna, na ɔde ne ho akɔbata ne yere ho, na wɔn baanu abɛyɛ honam korɔ? 6#1 Ko 7.10-11 Enti na wɔnna so nyɛ baanu bio, na mmom wɔyɛ honam korɔ. Enti deɛ Onyankopɔn de abom no, mma onipa biara nntete mu. 7#Deut 24.1 Wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Na adɛn nti na Mose hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmma awaregyaeɛ nwoma, na wɔnnyaa no no? 8Ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo akomaden nti na Mose maa mo kwan sɛ monnyaa mo yerenom; na ɛfiri mfitiaseɛ no, anka ɛnte saa. 9#Luka 16.18 Enti mese mo sɛ, sɛ ɛnyɛ adwamammɔ nti na obi gyaa ne yere na ɔware foforɔ a, na wasɛe awadeɛ; (na deɛ ɔbɛware deɛ wɔagyae no no nso asɛe awadeɛ.)#19.9 Tete atwerɛ a wɔgye to mu binom mfa saa ɔfa yi a ɛwɔ nkahyɛmudeɛ yi nka ho. 10Asuafoɔ no see no sɛ: Sɛ ɔbarima ne ne yere ntam asɛm te saa deɛ a, na ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔwareɛ. 11#1 Ko 7.7; 7.17 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛnyɛ nnipa nyinaa na ɛbɛtumi agye asɛm yi, gye wɔn a wɔde ama wɔn. 12Na nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wɔntumi nwareɛ a wɔwoo wɔn saa firii wɔn na yam, na ebinom nso wɔ hɔ a nnipa na ɛyɛɛ wɔn saa; na ebinom nso wɔ hɔ a ɔsoro ahennie nti na wɔayɛ wɔn ho saa. Deɛ ɔbɛtumi agyeɛ no, ma no nnye.
Yesu hyira mmɔfra
(Marko 10.13-16; Luka 18.15-17)
13Ɛnna wɔde mmɔfra brɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa ne nsa ngu wɔn so mmɔ mpaeɛ mma wɔn; nanso asuafoɔ no kaa nnipa a wɔde wɔn baeɛ no anim. 14#Mat 18.2-3 Na Yesu kaa sɛ: Momma mmɔfra no kwan na monnsi wɔn me nkyɛn ba kwan; na yeinom sɛɛ yi na ɔsoro ahennie no yɛ wɔn dea. 15Na ɔde ne nsa guu wɔn so hyiraa wɔn na ɔfiri hɔ kɔeɛ.
Daa nkwa
(Marko 10.17-31; Luka 18.18-30)
16Na hwɛ, obi baa hɔ bɛsee no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, adepa bɛn na menyɛ na manya daa nkwa? 17#Luka 10.26-28 Na ɔsee no sɛ: Adɛn nti na wobisa me papa ho asɛm? Ɔbaako na ɔyɛ. Na sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokɔ nkwa mu a, di mmara nsɛm no so! 18#Eks 20.12-16 Ɔsee Yesu sɛ: Deɛ ɛwɔ he? Ɛnna Yesu se: Deɛ ɛse: Nni awu! Nsɛe awadeɛ! Mmɔ korɔno! Nni adansekurumu! 19#Lew 19.18 Di w’agya ne wo na ni! Dɔ wo yɔnko sɛ wo ho! 20Aberanteɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Madi yeinom nyinaa so. Ɛdeɛn na aka me bio? 21#Mat 6.20; Luka 12.33 Yesu see no sɛ: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woyɛ pɛ a, kɔ na kɔtɔn deɛ wowɔ, na fa ma ahiafoɔ, na wobɛnya agyapadeɛ wɔ soro, na bra bɛdi m’akyi! 22#Dwom 62.10 Aberanteɛ no tee asɛm yi no, ɔde awerɛhoɔ kɔeɛ; ɛfiri sɛ na ɔwɔ ahonyadeɛ bebree. 23Ɛnna Yesu ka kyerɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, ɛyɛ den ma ɔdefoɔ sɛ ɔbɛkɔ ɔsoro ahennie mu.
Ahonyadeɛ ho mmusuo
24 Na bio mese mo sɛ, ɛyɛ mmerɛ ma yoma sɛ ɔbɛfa paneɛ tokuro mu sene sɛ ɔdefoɔ bɛkɔ Nyankopɔn ahennie mu. 25Na n’asuafoɔ no teeɛ no, ɛyɛɛ wɔn ahodwiri pii, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɛnneɛ na hwan na wɔbɛtumi agye no nkwa? 26Na Yesu hwɛɛ wɔn, see wɔn sɛ: Onipa fam na yei ntumi nyɛ hɔ, na Nyankopɔn fam deɛ nnoɔma nyinaa bɛtumi ayɛ hɔ.
Ahopakyire
27Ɛnna Petro bua see no sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛagya nnoɔma nyinaa hɔ abɛdi w’akyi. Ɛdeɛn koraa na yɛbɛnya? 28#Luka 22.30 Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, mo a moabɛdi m’akyire yi, wiase foforɔ no mu no, ɛda a Onipa Ba no bɛtena n’animuonyam ahennwa soɔ no, mo nso mobɛtena ahennwa dummienu so, abu Israel mmusuakuo dummienu no atɛn. 29#Heb 10.34 Na obiara a me nti wagya afie, anaa nuammarima anaa nuammaa, anaa agya anaa ɛna anaa mma, anaa nsase hɔ no, ɔbɛnya no mmɔho ɔha na wanya daa nkwa afa. 30#Mat 20.16; Luka 13.30 Na adikanfoɔ pii bɛdi akyire, na akyikafoɔ abɛdi kan.

Na ɛbaa sɛ Yesu wiee nsɛm yi ka no, ɔfirii Galilea, na ɔbaa Yudea ahyeɛ so, Yordan agya. Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo pii dii n’akyi, na ɔsaa wɔn yadeɛ wɔ hɔ.

Na Farisifoɔ baa ne nkyɛn bɛsɔɔ no hwɛe, sɛ: Obi wɔ ho kwan sɛ asɛm biara nti ɔgyaa ne yere anaa? Enti deɛ Onyankopɔn de abom no, mma onipa biara nntete mu. Wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Na adɛn nti na Mose hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmma awaregyaeɛ nwoma, na wɔnnyaa no no? Ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo akomaden nti na Mose maa mo kwan sɛ monnyaa mo yerenom; na ɛfiri mfitiaseɛ no, anka ɛnte saa. Enti mese mo sɛ, sɛ ɛnyɛ adwamammɔ nti na obi gyaa ne yere na ɔware foforɔ a, na wasɛe awadeɛ; (na deɛ ɔbɛware deɛ wɔagyae no no nso asɛe awadeɛ.) Deɛ ɔbɛtumi agyeɛ no, ma no nnye.


Ɛnna wɔde mmɔfra brɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa ne nsa ngu wɔn so mmɔ mpaeɛ mma wɔn; nanso asuafoɔ no kaa nnipa a wɔde wɔn baeɛ no anim. Na Yesu kaa sɛ: Momma mmɔfra no kwan na monnsi wɔn me nkyɛn ba kwan; na yeinom sɛɛ yi na ɔsoro ahennie no yɛ wɔn dea. Na ɔde ne nsa guu wɔn so hyiraa wɔn na ɔfiri hɔ kɔeɛ.


Na hwɛ, obi baa hɔ bɛsee no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, adepa bɛn na menyɛ na manya daa nkwa? Na ɔsee no sɛ: Adɛn nti na wobisa me papa ho asɛm? Ɔbaako na ɔyɛ. Na sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokɔ nkwa mu a, di mmara nsɛm no so! Ɔsee Yesu sɛ: Deɛ ɛwɔ he? Ɛnna Yesu se: Deɛ ɛse: Nni awu! Nsɛe awadeɛ! Mmɔ korɔno! Nni adansekurumu! Di w’agya ne wo na ni! Dɔ wo yɔnko sɛ wo ho! Aberanteɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Madi yeinom nyinaa so. Ɛdeɛn na aka me bio? Yesu see no sɛ: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woyɛ pɛ a, kɔ na kɔtɔn deɛ wowɔ, na fa ma ahiafoɔ, na wobɛnya agyapadeɛ wɔ soro, na bra bɛdi m’akyi! Aberanteɛ no tee asɛm yi no, ɔde awerɛhoɔ kɔeɛ; ɛfiri sɛ na ɔwɔ ahonyadeɛ bebree. Ɛnna Yesu ka kyerɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, ɛyɛ den ma ɔdefoɔ sɛ ɔbɛkɔ ɔsoro ahennie mu.

Ɛnna Petro bua see no sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛagya nnoɔma nyinaa hɔ abɛdi w’akyi. Ɛdeɛn koraa na yɛbɛnya? app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
